**Best fit: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 with two 200 W solar panels.** It has a 2,073.6 Wh LiFePO₄ battery and 2,600 W AC output, so it’s a close match to your 2,000 Wh target with useful headroom. The bundled 400 W of panels is a better match than a single 200 W panel; the guide estimates roughly 1–1.5 sunny days for a recharge, and lists the kit at $1,499. [Kit details and pricing](https://dealectric.com/best-2000wh-solar-generator-kit-with-panels)

If you want to spend less, the same guide lists a one-panel version at $1,199, but estimates 2–3 sunny days to recharge from that 200 W panel. [One-panel kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit)

judge.top_pick: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
